title: Sync disk writes and clear inactive memory caches
summary: This command sequence first ensures all disk writes are complete, then clears inactive memory and filesystem caches. This can help free up RAM and ensure a clean state for disk operations.

steps.explain: Run sync to flush disk writes, then use sudo purge to clear inactive memory and filesystem caches.

warnings: Clearing caches may temporarily slow down the system as it rebuilds them.

rollback.explain: There is no direct undo for clearing caches; the system will rebuild them automatically as needed.
